capabilities: aggregate TODOs from the whole vault in a sidebar list
build Kanban boards with customizable columns and drag-and-drop
set task priorities, due dates, tags, and pins
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian tasks live inline inside individual notes, so there is no single place to see, sort, and move tasks across the whole vault.
summary: Task manager that collects TODOs from vault notes into a sidebar list and Kanban boards with priorities, sub-tasks, and drag-and-drop columns.
